invariants.rationale: The method always returns a Pair constructed from two (possibly empty) objects, so result is never null.
The left value of the returned Pair (the partitionPathStatMap) is always a HashMap, never null.
The right value of the returned Pair (the globalStat) is always a new WorkloadStat, never null.
There is at most one unique partition path per inputRecord; thus, the map size cannot exceed inputRecords.
If there is any input, then at least one partition must be present in the map.
